_comment: Expected enabled/disabled state of every GitHub Actions workflow.
A workflow's disabled state lives in GitHub, NOT in the repo — `gh workflow disable` leaves no
trace in git. So every gate in this repo passed while ten scheduled lanes, including the only
monitor, were switched off and the YAML schedules were fiction. This file is the missing half:
scripts/check_workflow_state.py diffs it against the live API, so a freeze or a thaw has to be
To change a workflow's state: run `gh workflow enable|disable <file>` AND update this file in

acquire-audit.yml.reason: Thawed 2026-08-04. The 2026-08-01 freeze was never a cost necessity: the overage was backfill campaigns (36.9M of July's 68.1M rows on three days), not these lanes. The three lanes that DID carry avoidable cost - EVDS, weekly, TEFAS - re-stamped unchanged rows and re-shipped them to D1; all three now compare before writing (see OPERATIONS.md, D1 write budget), taking the quiet baseline to roughly 7M/month against 50M included.

analyst-daily.yml.reason: Active but UNSCHEDULED — dispatch-only under the 2026-08-01 D1-write freeze. Produces signals+memos as run artifacts; contains NO D1 push step at all. The daily 07:00 UTC cron and the push steps go in when the freeze lifts (see the workflow header).

analyst-research.yml.reason: Active but UNSCHEDULED and ARTIFACT-ONLY - the V2 agentic-research lane in its evaluation phase. No D1 writes of any kind, no schedule, nothing publishes automatically; V1 (analyst-daily.yml) remains the baseline. Publishing integration only after the evaluation corpus and explicit human approval (docs/ANALYST_V2.md).

backfill-audit-source-capture.yml.reason: Active but DISPATCH-ONLY. Evidence-only historical upgrade for normalized/summary audit tables; no schedule, and content-idempotent D1 writes are limited to compact manifests plus changed validation rows.

backfill-document-capture.yml.reason: Active but DISPATCH-ONLY. Full-document table capture (rows/columns/cells + linked notes) for the whole corpus; calls no analytical upsert, so it is safe over the frozen BS/P&L. The raw ledger stays local/R2 in its own DB; D1 receives only the one-row-per-filing bank_audit_document_manifest.

measure-free-provision.yml.reason: Active but DISPATCH-ONLY and READ-ONLY - a corpus measurement, not a lane. Downloads each audit PDF from R2, re-runs the free-provision classifier and diffs against the snapshot's stored values; writes nothing (no D1, no R2 upload, no snapshot write) and returns the diff as an artifact. No schedule: a new workflow is born enabled, and a scheduled job that pulls ~580 PDFs is not something to acquire by accident.

refresh-evds-daily.yml.reason: Thawed 2026-08-04 with the rest. Held back for a few hours on operator's call, then re-enabled: the re-stamp bug that made this lane expensive was fixed 2026-07-27 (it now writes only series whose value moved), and EVDS is genuinely daily data - FX, policy rate and CBRT funding are ~2,116 daily observations each. Running it weekly instead would have pushed age past both freshness thresholds (healthcheck 120h, admin-health 3-day cadence) and produced a false alert most weeks. Note refresh-data.yml (Sat 03:00) also refreshes EVDS; post-fix that redundancy costs ~nothing.

refresh-transcripts-weekly.yml.reason: Active but UNSCHEDULED — the file carries workflow_dispatch only, so nothing fires it. The schedule (Sat 07:00 UTC) and the push input's true default go in when the freeze lifts.
